title: Existence of Positive Mild Eigenfunctions for Caputo Fractional Semilinear Evolution Equations with Nonlocal Initial Conditions
summary: We study the existence of positive eigenpairs for a class of Caputo fractional autonomous evolution equations with nonlocal initial condition within the framework of Banach lattices. The autonomous linear operator generates a compact strongly continuous semigroup of contractions, while the nonlinearity is a Caratheodory map. The mild eigenfunction is represented via the compact Mittag--Leffler operator families, we work within a positive cone of continuous functions and establish a uniform lower bound for the solution operator on the boundary.
